title: Democratic Quality Scorecard: Independent Police Complaints and Misconduct Authority Bill

dimensions.evidence: Protects Article 21 life and dignity by creating an independent remedy for police brutality.
Provides accessible complaint mechanism for all citizens regardless of status.
Binding investigative and prosecution directions issued by retired judicial heads.
PCA operates completely independent of police hierarchy and political executive.
Mandatory open portal tracking complaint statuses and prosecution outcomes.
Binding statutory directions for FIR registration and disciplinary prosecution.
13 languages, direct online portal and district drop-boxes.
